sources.title: Random Tilings of High Symmetry: II. Boundary Conditions and Numerical Studies
sources.authors: M. Widom, N. Destainville, R. Mosseri, F. Bailly
sources.scope: Introduction and Section 2; complete Appendix A opening and diagonal argument text through printed p.867; references 10 and 11 followed. PDF pp.25-27 visually inspected in full using cropbox rendering. No audit of all Appendix B asymptotics or all other claims is asserted.
sources.finding: Does not furnish a separately rigorous finite-count proof of (H); scalar fixed-D convergence is not refuted by its stronger thermodynamic-limit vocabulary.

sources.title: Entropy and Boundary Conditions in Random Lozenge Tilings
sources.journal_title: Entropy and boundary conditions in random rhombus tilings
sources.access: Primary author preprint inspected through web PDF reader; not downloaded locally
sources.scope: Definition of zonotopal fixed boundary and growing-side limit, Sections 2.2-2.3, Eqs.(7),(15)-(18), and thermodynamic-limit terminology on printed pp.12-13
sources.finding: Interface correction cancellation, saddle-point regularity, and general strict concavity are not supplied as rigorous quantitative estimates proving arbitrary fixed-D (H).

sources.title: A Variational Principle for Domino Tilings
sources.authors: H. Cohn, R. Kenyon, J. Propp
sources.access: Primary paper inspected through web PDF reader; not downloaded locally
sources.scope: Abstract, Section 1 description and Theorem 1.1; not a full independent proof audit of the domino variational theorem
sources.finding: Stated model covers domino/dimer and three-direction lozenge tilings. No supplied reduction makes it (H) for arbitrary D.
